text:
Hi, I’m Mina Castellan. I have 5 years of experience in data analysis, data entry, and dashboard work, with strong skills in SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data cleaning, and data visualization.

For Juniper & Ash Home, I built Shopify customer segments from order exports using recency, frequency, and spend in Google Sheets and Looker Studio, then fed them to the email tool. The top segment represented 9% of customers and 41% of revenue, and email revenue increased by 19%.

I can help manage daily outreach tasks, keep lists clean, and support ongoing campaign operations. I’m available for 4 hours per day, and my proposed rate is $5/hour.

What tools and process do you currently use for the email outreach campaigns?
